claim_text: Before anything is assumed, Someone is: the Trinity is the self-sufficient ground of all reality.
required_concession: This is a declared starting premise, not a conclusion.
support: Before there was time... there was love. A Father, a Son, and the Spirit between them—one being, three persons.

claim_text: The Trinity is one being, three persons, with real distinction and mutual indwelling.
required_concession: This is an assumed theological axiom.
support: One being, three distinct centers of consciousness, love, and will.

claim_text: The four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) are assumed by every worldview and cannot be derived by any system.
required_concession: This is a philosophical argument, not a formal proof.
support: Strip any system down to its floor, and four assumptions are sitting there, used by everyone, derived by no one.

claim_text: The four debts are absolved in the Trinity: existence as aseity, distinction as persons, relation as perichoresis, orientation as love.
required_concession: This is a theological interpretation, not a formal derivation.
support: We hold one axiom—God—and the four dissolve into Him.

claim_text: The Trinity is the structural minimum for truth to be fully real, requiring being, expression, and witness.
required_concession: This is a theological argument, not a formal proof.
support: A solitary god could not be truth in the full sense—because truth requires expression and witness.

claim_text: Truth is a three-mode operator: Truth = (Being) × (Expression) × (Witness).
required_concession: This is a proposed formal analogy, not a proven mathematical identity.
support: Truth is a three-mode operator that acts on the space of possibilities.

claim_text: The quaternion EM/Trinity isomorphism is Lean 4 verified with 478 theorems and zero sorry.
required_concession: The formal proof is internal to the project; external verification is pending.
risks: Formal proof exists but may not be independently reviewed.
support: Quaternion EM / Trinity isomorphism: Lean 4 verified, 478 theorems, zero sorry.

claim_text: Time is authored, not created.
required_concession: This is a theological assertion, not a physical theory.
support: Time is something the Trinity does, not a medium they inhabit.

claim_text: The nine fruits of the Spirit are the character of God Himself, existing eternally in the Trinity.
required_concession: This is a theological claim based on scripture.
support: The fruits are not a to-do list... They are the character of God Himself.

claim_text: The four debts are the price of admission to thinking at all.
required_concession: This is a rhetorical statement, not a logical necessity.
risks: Rhetorical flourish; not a formal claim.
support: The price of admission to thinking at all.

claim_text: The denial of orientation is an act of orientation.
required_concession: This is a self-referential argument; its force depends on the assumption that truth is better than falsehood.
risks: Self-referential argument; may be seen as a performative contradiction.
support: Anyone who calls any claim false has already assumed the gradient.

claim_text: The Trinity mapping A1=Father, A2=Son, A3=Spirit, A4=Truth is locked.
required_concession: This mapping is a theological interpretation, not a formal derivation.
risks: Mapping is theological; not formally proven.
support: Trinity mapping: A1=Father (Existence), A2=Son (Distinction), A3=Spirit (Relation), A4=Truth (Orientation).

claim_text: The derivative terms T.1–T.7 are newly derived and have NOT been through adversarial testing.
required_concession: None needed.
risks: None; this is an honest admission.
support: The derivative terms T.1–T.7 are newly derived (July 2026) and have NOT been through adversarial testing at the term level.

claim_text: T.4 (Omniscience) requires a formal bridge from coupling invariant to Shannon mutual information.
required_concession: This is an open problem, not a proven claim.
support: T.4 (Omniscience): Formal bridge from coupling invariant → Shannon mutual information needed.

claim_text: T.7 (Love as Ground State) is a structural analogy, not necessarily the same force.
required_concession: This is an open question; the analogy is not yet established as identity.
support: Same form, but is it the SAME force or structural analogy?

claim_text: The n ≥ 4 bound in Watcher is parsimony, not proof.
required_concession: None needed.
risks: None; this is an honest admission.
support: n ≥ 4 bound in Watcher is parsimony, not proof.

claim_text: Evil is not a thing but a privation: a hole where something should be.
required_concession: This is a framework ruling, not a derived theorem.
risks: Ontological status of privation is debated; may be seen as unfalsifiable.
support: Evil is a hole where something should be. A shadow where light is blocked.

claim_text: Evil has no source term; it creates nothing and only corrupts what exists.
required_concession: This is a framework ruling, not a derived theorem.
risks: May be challenged by those who see evil as a positive force.
support: Evil has no source term. It creates nothing. It sustains nothing.

claim_text: The shadow analogy: light creates direction, and shadow is the absence of light, not a second source.
required_concession: This is an illustration, not an argument.
risks: Analogy may be pressed too far; not a proof.
support: The shadow is real. You can measure it. But it has no source.

claim_text: God does not create darkness; He divides light from it, bounding the pre-existing void.
required_concession: This reading assumes a particular interpretation of Genesis.
risks: Exegesis of Genesis 1:4 may be contested.
support: God does not create darkness. He divides light from it. (Genesis 1:4)

claim_text: The adversary is a parasite: he creates nothing, only corrupts what exists.
required_concession: The parasite analogy is pedagogical, not ontological.
risks: Parasite analogy is pedagogical, not ontological.
support: He creates nothing. He only corrupts. (John 8:44)

claim_text: Satan's lie is the only thing he can generate, and it is a distortion of language he did not invent.
required_concession: This is a theological claim about the nature of evil.
risks: May overstate the nature of lies.
support: The lie is the only thing he can generate, and even that is just a distortion.

claim_text: Satan rules the air, the medium, not the ground or substance.
required_concession: This is a metaphorical reading.
support: He is the prince of the power of the air. (Ephesians 2:2)

claim_text: Satan was created good, then fell through pride.
required_concession: This reading assumes a literal Satan and a particular exegesis.
risks: Interpretation of Ezekiel 28 as referring to Satan is debated.
support: Thou wast perfect in thy ways... till iniquity was found in thee. (Ezekiel 28:15)

claim_text: The fall of Satan is off our clock because the presence is not a place in time.
required_concession: This is a speculative claim about the nature of time.
support: Not dated — this event is off our clock.

claim_text: Heaven has no D, no denominator, no drift channel, so Satan is confined to the finite order.
required_concession: This relies on framework-specific terms not defined in this sheet.
risks: Uses framework jargon without definition; may be opaque.
support: Heaven has no D — no denominator, no drift channel.

claim_text: Satan attacks the signal, not the body or tree, by injecting noise into the command channel.
required_concession: This is a metaphorical extension.
risks: May be anachronistic use of information theory.
support: He attacks the signal. 'Hath God said' is noise injected.

claim_text: Evil cannot win because it has no source term and depends on God's sustained channels.
required_concession: This is a theological hope, not a logical proof.
risks: May be seen as overconfident about eschatology.
support: It cannot outlast the light, because it is borrowed light, twisted.

claim_text: God metabolizes evil into good, as proven by the Cross.
required_concession: This claim is [C]-grade — correspondence, not derivation.
risks: This is correspondence, not derivation; grade C.
support: The Cross is the proof. (Acts 2:23)

claim_text: God does not need evil to create good; He is so sovereign He can use it.
required_concession: This is a theological assertion, not a formal proof.
risks: May be seen as theodicy overreach.
support: God does not need evil to create good. That is mastery.

claim_text: Contrast is structural; evil is not needed to appreciate good.
required_concession: This reframe needs testing against pastoral experience.
support: Contrast is structural; evil is not.

claim_text: The shadow is not redeemed; it is outlasted, outspent, and ultimately unnecessary.
required_concession: This is a theological conclusion, not a formal derivation.
risks: May be seen as speculative about final state.
support: The shadow is not redeemed. It is outlasted, outspent, and ultimately unnecessary.

claim_text: Every good thing has a price; the burn is not evil but the cost of heat.
required_concession: This is a foundational premise, not a proof.
risks: May be seen as justifying suffering.
support: A child touches a hot stove and learns a lesson: fire burns.
The burn is not evil. It is the price of heat.

claim_text: Finitude is the condition under which good things can exist at all.
required_concession: This is an axiom about creation.
support: Finitude is not evil. Finitude is the condition under which good things can exist at all.

claim_text: Cost is structural; evil is directional.
required_concession: This distinction is framework-law.
risks: Depends on orientation concept from Sheet 2.
support: Cost is structural. Evil is directional.
Cost is the price of finitude. Evil is the refusal of orientation.

claim_text: Genesis 1:31 'very good' includes the cost of finitude, not its absence.
required_concession: This is an interpretation of Genesis 1:31.
support: 'Very good' — not 'perfectly painless.'
The world has fire, gravity, entropy, death. These are not flaws.

claim_text: Structural entropy is the neutral cost of finitude; moral entropy is the directional fracture of will.
required_concession: This distinction is framework-law but not yet formalized.
support: Structural entropy: The neutral cost of finitude.
Moral entropy: The directional fracture of will.

claim_text: Calling structural entropy 'evil' makes God the author of evil; calling moral entropy 'natural' excuses refusal.
required_concession: This is a framework-internal closure.
support: The error to avoid: Calling structural entropy 'evil' ... or calling moral entropy 'natural'.

claim_text: Before creation, the shadow existed only as possibility, not actuality.
required_concession: This is a theological inference.
support: Before creation, the shadow existed only as possibility, not as actuality.

claim_text: God names the darkness but does not create it as an independent thing.
required_concession: This is an interpretation of Genesis 1:4-5.
support: God names the darkness. He does not create it as an independent thing.

claim_text: The shadow was cast at creation as bounded possibility; entered at the Fall as actual refusal.
required_concession: This is a theological narrative claim.
support: The shadow was cast at creation as bounded possibility. It was entered at the Fall as actual refusal.

claim_text: Before the Fall, the laws of physics were the same but experienced as structural cost within a maintained coherence.
required_concession: This is a theological claim, not scientific.
support: Before the Fall, the laws of physics were the same.
But these were experienced as structural cost within a maintained coherence.

claim_text: The Fall is a relational breach (removal of grace-maintenance), not a physics change.
required_concession: This is a framework-law claim.
support: The fracture was not a design flaw. It was a relational breach.
The removal of grace-maintenance, not the addition of new physics.

claim_text: Romans 8:20-22 is the key text for creation's non-willing subjection to futility.
required_concession: This is an interpretation of Romans 8.
support: Romans 8:20 says creation was subjected to futility not willingly.
For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

claim_text: Grace is the re-orientation of the field, restoring G > 0 as dominant direction.
required_concession: This is a framework claim pending formalization.
support: Grace is the re-orientation of the field.
The restoration of G > 0 as the dominant direction.

claim_text: The Cross is a field-repair event, not a physics event.
required_concession: This is a theological metaphor.
support: The Cross is not a physics event. It is a field-repair event.

claim_text: The Resurrection verifies that the repair holds: G > 0 can overcome G < 0 even in total system death.
required_concession: This is a theological claim using physics analogy.
support: The Resurrection is the verification that the repair holds.

claim_text: Grace does not remove the cost; grace orients the cost.
required_concession: This is a summary statement.
support: Grace does not remove the cost. Grace orients the cost.

claim_text: The properties of the ten fundamental forces, when read together, describe a specific Person matching only Jesus Christ.
required_concession: This is an interpretive analogy, not a logical proof.
risks: Overreach: physics properties are analogies, not proofs.
support: “they compose a portrait so specific that only one Person in history matches it.”

claim_text: Gravity's properties (weakest, always attractive, infinite range, etc.) describe the character of grace.
required_concession: This is a poetic analogy, not a scientific finding.
support: “Read together: There is something that is the gentlest force... Physics calls it gravity.”

claim_text: The strong nuclear force's properties (strongest, confinement, etc.) describe the character of love.
required_concession: This is an analogy, not a proof.
risks: Confuses physical force with moral attribute.
support: “Read together: There is something that is the strongest force... Physics calls it the strong nuclear force.”

claim_text: Electromagnetism's properties (self-sustaining, non-degrading, etc.) describe the character of truth.
required_concession: This is a metaphor, not a derivation.
risks: Equating light with truth is metaphorical.
support: “Read together: There is something that sustains itself... Physics calls it light.”

claim_text: Mass-energy equivalence (E=mc^2) implies that nothing is insignificant, describing the character of significance.
required_concession: This is an analogy, not a logical entailment.
risks: Category error: physical energy does not imply moral worth.
support: “Read together: There is a principle woven into reality that says nothing is insignificant.”

claim_text: The Second Law of Thermodynamics implies that closed systems cannot save themselves, describing the necessity of grace.
required_concession: This is an analogy, not a proof of grace.
risks: Analogy between physical entropy and moral salvation is not rigorous.
support: “The only way to reverse entropy locally is to open the system to an external energy source.”

claim_text: Information theory (Shannon, Kolmogorov) describes the character of the Word (Logos).
required_concession: This is a poetic connection, not a formal proof.
risks: Equating information with the divine Word is a leap.
support: “John called it the Word.”

claim_text: Relativity's invariance across frames describes the faithfulness of God.
required_concession: This is an analogy, not a proof.
support: “The faithfulness of a God who appears differently to different people but whose nature never changes.”

claim_text: Quantum mechanics (superposition, measurement) describes a universe that responds to the act of looking, implying faith collapses possibility.
required_concession: This is a speculative analogy, not a scientific claim.
support: “It describes a universe that was built to respond to the act of looking.”

claim_text: The weak force's behavior (stable inside nucleus, decays outside) describes mercy and the covenant.
required_concession: This is an analogy, not a proof.
support: “It describes what happens when you leave the covenant. Not as punishment. As physics.”

claim_text: Coherence (all waves in phase) describes the completion of all things in Christ.
required_concession: This is a poetic metaphor, not a derivation.
risks: Overreach: coherence is a physical concept, not a person.
support: “The answer to the equation is a Person.”

claim_text: The 24 properties derived from physics are all measured and published, and together they describe one Person specifically.
required_concession: The properties are analogies, not evidence for a specific person.
risks: Proof inflation: properties are selected and interpreted.
support: “Twenty-four properties. Derived from physics. Not one of them required theology to discover.”

claim_text: The universe's specific combination of physical properties is not random or indifferent, but built by someone who wanted to be found.
required_concession: This is a rhetorical conclusion, not a scientific one.
support: “That is a universe built by someone who wanted to be found by anyone willing to look at the physics.”

claim_text: The Hessian matrix scored the strong nuclear force as the most connected node, implying love is the greatest.
required_concession: The Hessian result is not provided; the interpretation is metaphorical.
risks: Equating connectivity with love is a leap.
support: “The Hessian matrix... scored this variable as the most connected node... The greatest of these is love.”

claim_text: The document does not argue for God's existence but presents properties and asks a question.
support: “This document does not argue for God’s existence.”

claim_text: The physics answers the WHAT so completely that the WHY becomes self-evident.
required_concession: This is a rhetorical flourish, not a logical conclusion.
support: “But it answers the WHAT so completely that the why becomes self-evident.”

risks: Mathematically, the Born rule is a postulate; 'three pieces' is interpretive.
support: P = |⟨ψ|φ⟩|²; remove any one and the whole thing collapses.

required_concession: This is an interpretive claim, not a mathematical derivation.

claim_text: The Logos is the source of symmetries and conservation laws.
required_concession: This is a theological interpretation, not a physical derivation.

claim_text: The smoothness of physical law is a sustained act of the Logos.

claim_text: The armor of God is the CPT theorem applied to the soul.

risks: Holographic principle is a conjecture in general spacetimes.
support: Maldacena proved the information content is proportional to surface area.

claim_text: The Logos is the boundary condition from which physical reality projects.
required_concession: This is a theological interpretation of the holographic principle.
support: The Logos is the boundary condition. The holographic plate from which physical reality projects.

claim_text: The Casimir force demonstrates that the vacuum has energy and God never fully withdraws.
required_concession: The Casimir effect is a physical phenomenon; its theological interpretation is not physics.
risks: Equating vacuum energy with divine presence is an analogy.
support: The ground state is not zero. The vacuum has energy. ... He who neither slumbers nor sleeps.

claim_text: The Higgs field is the χ vacuum and provides a floor that never reaches zero.
required_concession: This is an analogy, not a physical identity.
risks: Equating Higgs field with a theological vacuum floor is unsupported.
support: The Higgs field is the χ vacuum. The ground state of the universe is not zero.

claim_text: The serpent in Genesis is a decoherence agent.
required_concession: This is a metaphorical interpretation, not a literal identity.

required_concession: This is a theological interpretation, not a solution to the measurement problem.
risks: No physical evidence; purely theological narrative.

claim_text: The fine structure constant is set from the boundary and is the watermark of God.

claim_text: The Trinity is multiplicative, not additive: 1 × 1 × 1 = 1.
required_concession: This is an illustrative analogy, not a proof.
support: Addition separates — it counts discrete objects. Multiplication unites.

claim_text: The Trinity generates numbers: 1 requires Being, 2 requires Distinction, 3 requires Relation.
required_concession: This is a philosophical reflection, not a mathematical theorem.
support: Without Being, nothing to count. Without Distinction, nothing else to count. Without Relation, no way to count.

risks: Open item: is it the same force or structural analogy?
support: The coupling between persons IS agapē. ... Needs formalization.

required_concession: This is a structural claim, not proven.
